name: cards
definition: 一种可被玩家在集换式卡牌游戏中使用或收藏的印刷品，具有名称、颜色标识、法术力费用等属性。 Counterexample: 卡牌与卡牌系列（set）不同：卡牌是单张印刷品，系列是卡牌的发行集合。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table cards; provenance: direct source cards

name: foreign_data
definition: 记录卡牌在非英文语言下的名称、文本、风味文本等信息的条目。 Counterexample: 外文卡牌数据与卡牌本身不同：前者是卡牌的多语言文本记录，后者是卡牌实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table foreign_data; provenance: direct source foreign_data

name: legalities
definition: 记录某张卡牌在特定比赛赛制下是否允许使用的状态条目。 Counterexample: 赛制合法性与卡牌不同：前者是卡牌在赛制中的使用状态，后者是卡牌实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table legalities; provenance: direct source legalities

name: rulings
definition: 记录官方对某张卡牌规则解释或判例的文本条目，包含日期和内容。 Counterexample: 卡牌裁定与卡牌文本不同：前者是官方对规则的解释，后者是卡牌印刷的规则文本。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table rulings; provenance: direct source rulings

name: set_translations
definition: 记录卡牌系列名称在非英文语言下的翻译文本的条目。 Counterexample: 系列翻译与系列不同：前者是系列名称的多语言文本，后者是卡牌发行集合。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table set_translations; provenance: direct source set_translations

name: sets
definition: 卡牌游戏中的一次发行集合，包含若干卡牌，具有代码、名称、发行日期等属性。 Counterexample: 卡牌系列与卡牌不同：系列是卡牌的发行集合，卡牌是系列中的单张印刷品。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table sets; provenance: direct source sets

name: CardName
definition: The English name of a Magic card.

name: SetName
definition: The English name of a card set.

name: SetCode
definition: The short code identifying a card set.

name: SetTranslation
definition: Localized name of a card set in a given language.

name: Language
definition: Language of the card text or set translation.

name: ForeignName
definition: Localized card name in a foreign language.

name: ForeignFlavorText
definition: Localized flavor text of a card.

name: RulingText
definition: Text of an official ruling for a card.

name: Format
definition: A tournament format in which a card's legality is defined.

name: LegalityStatus
definition: Legality status of a card in a given format.

name: BannedCard
definition: A card whose legality status is 'Banned' in a format.

name: LegalCard
definition: A card whose legality status is 'Legal' in a format.

name: CommanderFormat
definition: The Commander (EDH) tournament format.

name: GladiatorFormat
definition: The Gladiator tournament format.

name: ContentWarning
definition: Flag indicating a card has a content warning.

name: NoContentWarning
definition: Cards that do not have a content warning.
aliases: do not have a content warning

name: StorySpotlight
definition: Flag indicating a card is part of a story spotlight.

name: EdhrecRank
definition: EDHRec popularity ranking of a card.

name: ConvertedManaCost
definition: Converted mana cost (CMC) of a card.

name: BorderColor
definition: Border color of a card.

name: Artist
definition: Name of the artist who illustrated the card.

name: MtgoCode
definition: MTGO code of a set; non-null means the set is available on MTGO.
scope: sets where mtgoCode IS NOT NULL
aliases: appear on Magic: The Gathering Online

name: McmName
definition: CardMarket (MCM) name of a set.
aliases: known as on magic card market

name: Block
definition: Block to which a set belongs.

name: Power
definition: Power value of a creature card.
scope: cards where power IS NULL OR power = '*'

name: Rarity
definition: Rarity level of a card printing.

name: PercentageOfCardsWithoutContentWarningInCommander
definition: Share of Commander-legal cards that have no content warning. Formula: COUNT(NoContentWarning AND CommanderFormat AND LegalCard) / COUNT(CommanderFormat AND LegalCard) * 100. Inputs: NoContentWarning = cards.hasContentWarning WHERE hasContentWarning = 0; CommanderFormat = legalities.format WHERE format = 'commander'; LegalCard = legalities.status WHERE status = 'Legal'
aliases: percentage of cards with format commander and legal status d
percentage of cards without content warning in commander

name: PercentageOfFrenchStorySpotlightCards
definition: Share of Story Spotlight cards that have a French version. Formula: COUNT(StorySpotlight AND Language = 'French') / COUNT(StorySpotlight) * 100. Inputs: StorySpotlight = cards.isStorySpotlight WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1; Language = foreign_data.language
aliases: percentage of cards whose language is French among the Story
percentage of french story spotlight cards

name: PercentageOfFrenchCardsWithoutPower
definition: Share of cards without power that have a French version. Formula: COUNT(Power IS NULL OR Power = '*' AND Language = 'French') / COUNT(Power IS NULL OR Power = '*') * 100. Inputs: Power = cards.power WHERE power IS NULL OR power = '*'; Language = foreign_data.language
aliases: percentage of cards without power are in French
percentage of french cards without power

name: CountOfBannedWhiteBorderCards
definition: Number of banned cards with white border. Formula: COUNT(BannedCard AND BorderColor = 'white'). Inputs: BannedCard = legalities.status WHERE status = 'Banned'; BorderColor = cards.borderColor WHERE borderColor = 'white'
aliases: how many of the banned cards are white border
count of banned white border cards

name: CountOfBrazilianPortugueseSetsInCommanderBlock
definition: Number of sets in the Commander block that have a Brazilian Portuguese translation. Formula: COUNT(Block = 'Commander' AND Language = 'Portuguese (Brasil)'). Inputs: Block = sets.block WHERE block = 'Commander'; Language = foreign_data.language; SetTranslation = set_translations.translation
aliases: how many Brazilian Portuguese translated sets are inside the
count of brazilian portuguese sets in commander block

name: CountOfCardsByAdamRexInHauptsetZehnteEdition
definition: Number of cards in the set 'Hauptset Zehnte Edition' illustrated by Adam Rex. Formula: COUNT(SetTranslation = 'Hauptset Zehnte Edition' AND Artist = 'Adam Rex'). Inputs: SetTranslation = set_translations.translation; Artist = cards.artist
aliases: among the cards in the set Hauptset Zehnte Edition, how many
count of cards by adam rex in hauptset zehnte edition

name: CountOfSummonAngelWithOtherSubtype
definition: Number of cards with original type 'Summon - Angel' whose subtype is not 'Angel'. Formula: COUNT(type = 'Summon - Angel' AND subtypes != 'Angel'). Inputs: CardName = cards.name
aliases: how many cards with original type of Summon - Angel have sub
count of summon angel with other subtype

name: CmcDifferenceSerraAngelVsShrineKeeper
definition: Difference in converted mana cost between Serra Angel and Shrine Keeper. Formula: ConvertedManaCost(CardName = 'Serra Angel') - ConvertedManaCost(CardName = 'Shrine Keeper'). Inputs: ConvertedManaCost = cards.convertedManaCost; CardName = cards.name
aliases: which card costs more converted mana, Serra Angel or Shrine
cmc difference serra angel vs shrine keeper

name: CountOfMythicBannedInGladiator
definition: Number of mythic rarity cards banned in Gladiator format. Formula: COUNT(Rarity = 'mythic' AND BannedCard AND GladiatorFormat). Inputs: Rarity = cards.rarity WHERE rarity = 'mythic'; BannedCard = legalities.status WHERE status = 'Banned'; GladiatorFormat = legalities.format WHERE format = 'gladiator'
aliases: list all the mythic rarity print cards banned in gladiator f
count of mythic banned in gladiator

name: CountOfEdhrecRank1BannedCards
definition: Number of cards ranked 1st on EDHRec that are banned in some format. Formula: COUNT(EdhrecRank = 1 AND BannedCard). Inputs: EdhrecRank = cards.edhrecRank WHERE edhrecRank = 1; BannedCard = legalities.status WHERE status = 'Banned'
aliases: which cards are ranked 1st on EDHRec, list all of the cards
count of edhrec rank 1 banned cards

name: CardLegality
definition: Which formats a card is legal, banned, or restricted in.

name: CardLanguage
definition: Languages in which a card or set is available.

name: SetType
definition: Category of a card set (core, expansion, commander, etc.).

name: CardRarity
definition: Rarity level of a card printing.

name: BorderColor
definition: Border color of a card.
